site: Land East of Vaynor Farm Llanddowror
description: Roman activity within an earlier henge monument. Deposits of cremated animal remains and grain, as well as two four post structures within the henge. Ritual or funerary use has been suggested, but only tentatively. The RSRB marks it as a 'shrine'. Dating comes from pottery and carbon dates.
